name: Lio
description: Lio is a self-hostable, deterministic cross-browser bookmark and tab synchronization server. It preserves hierarchy, exact positioning, and active tab sessions across Chrome, Firefox, Edge, and Brave with an embedded web management console.

notes.text: Lio runs on port 8000 by default, serving both the sync API and the embedded Web Management Console (zero Node.js required on server).
First-run setup will prompt you to set an admin password upon opening the Web Console at http://<ip>:8000 (or via CLI `python -m lio_server --set-admin admin <password>`).
Designed for local LAN usage over HTTP out of the box (LIO_COOKIE_SECURE=0). WebSockets run natively on ws://.
